# Terra Laboratories

> The autonomy layer for land-based fish farms. Terra forecasts a DO crash or biofilter collapse hours ahead and acts on it on-site, offline, behind a full audit log.

## What Terra does
- Forecasts water-quality failures (dissolved-oxygen crash, ammonia spike, biofilter collapse) hours ahead in recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS), from the whole-system state rather than a single probe.
- Acts autonomously within operator-set limits (aerate, dose, alert), with no cloud and no network required. Every action is logged.
- Runs one engine across domains: aquaculture first, then water and bioprocess, and eventually bioregenerative life support for space.

## Technology
- Edge-deployed Bayesian state estimator: unscented Kalman filtering on-device, Hamiltonian Monte Carlo calibration, sensor-drift separation and consistency self-checks.

## Stage (stated honestly)
- Pre-revenue. Validated in simulation on a real-data foundation. Bench validation planned Q4 2026; first paid pilots H1 2027.
- Pricing is value-share: the customer pays when Terra prevents a loss.

## Who it is for / not for
- For: land-based, recirculating aquaculture operators.
- Not yet for: net-pen or open-pond operations.
